releases.notes: Anubis port: Tpahere Kill Bot (with its sell routine and tab-completion lookups); NOTICE lists every Anubis port; 1.0.95

DonutSMP features from the Anubis client (GPL-3.0, 4ldenz, https://github.com/4ldenz/Anubis-client), after checking its jar for RATs (none: no token use, no hidden classes, webhooks only to your own URL): Spawner Protect (when blocks get broken near you it mines your spawners into an ender chest, buying one from /shop if needed, then leaves; player arrivals ping a webhook), Player Detection (alert, leave, toggle modules or webhook when another player loads in; Panic Pay left out), Coord Snapper (one key copies the coords you look at or stand on), and a Donut mode for No Fall. Auto Reconnect no longer rejoins after those leave on purpose, Anti Vanish ignores your own fake players, NOTICE credits Anubis; 1.0.94

Anti Vanish built for DonutSMP: watches staff only there (Anubis's 21 Donut staff names, editable, plus tab-list staff ranks), learns whether a server sends leave messages (Donut doesn't, so a silent leave is only noted), catches vanish as hidden-from-tab or off-tab-but-body-still-here, flags staff invisible near you, probes minecraft:msg every 10s while ignoring names seen in chat (other shards), starts over on shard change, and shows a big Staff watching you title. Staff List knows the Donut staff names on Donut. Detection approach and staff names follow the Anubis client (GPL-3.0, 4ldenz); 1.0.92

Anti Vanish (Misc): says when someone switches into spectator (and how close they were), when they come out of spectator or vanish within Watch Distance of you (they were watching you; teleported to you if they'd been far off), when someone drops off the tab list without a leave message (vanished), and every Find Every seconds asks the server which names /msg tab-completes to find players online but hidden. Who's Watching lists them; 1.0.91

Auto Web Escape: when you're webbed, switches to a water bucket, flicks onto the web and pours (the water washes it away), scoops the water back up for the next web and so you're not left swimming, then back to your weapon; real switches and clicks, one a tick, Legit Aura waits meanwhile. scripts/github_release.py publishes the build as a GitHub release, which femboyware.xyz serves; 1.0.50
